Name: Sebastian's Birthday Surprise
Author: tenthousandcats
TagLine: Adds mail, a quest, and a series of events about how Abigail, Sam, and the farmer surprise Sebastian on his birthday.
Description:
**I've decided to host this mod exclusively on [**ModDrop**](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/719168-sebastians-birthday-surprise)﻿﻿. Please head there for comments and bug reports. Thank you!**

[Korean translation available on Naver.](https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/154898)

Made for the official SDV server's Winter 2019 event. Have fun! 

How to trigger:
Only plays when the Community Center has been completed. Have at least 8 hearts with Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian. Have a fishing skill of 10. Event begins on Fall 27.

Compatibility:
**[Karmylla's Immersive Maps](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1149)**: compatible
**[Stardew Valley Reimagined](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4119)**: not yet tested
**Stardew Valley Expanded**: compatible
Any other dialogue or event mods: compatible
